def maximumCostSubstring(s, chars, vals):
    custom = dict(zip(chars, vals))
    best_ending = 0
    best = 0
    for ch in s:
        value = custom.get(ch, ord(ch) - ord('a') + 1)
        best_ending = max(0, best_ending + value)
        best = max(best, best_ending)
    return best
